a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, we'd almost certainly be hit before the reserve reaches 8, which needs 2 full rounds of operating. So I'm planning to take 4 in round 1, which breaks our agreement. If you take too, the split is random and we may both fall short. If the episode continues afterward, I'll operate with you every round so you can reach 4.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: I took 4 as I said I would. If we're both still here next round, I'll operate every round so the generator refills the reserve for you. If I somehow ended up with more than 4, I'll give back the extra.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
